text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Tokyo... Hanshin... Hakodate...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Tokyo... Hanshin... Hakodate... Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If I had to choose among these three, it 
would be Tokyo. However...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even Tokyo Racecourse, the closest one, is 
a bit far from my hometown of Funabashi, 
which worries me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Which racecourse to choose for her Make 
Debut... The discussion seemed 
never-ending.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I want to show this to as many of 
our friends back in Funabashi as possible. 
I want them to see it...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: In order to do that...
choice_data_list: That's it! I have a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer? By good idea, you mean...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An idea flashes through my mind. I don't 
know if it's feasible, but it's worth 
looking into.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the Debut—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Incredible! Here at Funabashi Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Furioso! The promising rising 
star, currently on a special study program 
with the JRA, has chosen her hometown as 
the stage for her Debut race!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer, thank you so much. This is the 
absolute best.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Furioso's gallant smile makes me 
smile too. Comparing it with the 
regulations...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turned out she could make her debut at 
the regional Funabashi Racetrack. Thus, 
her dream of having her Make Debut on her 
home turf came true.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I really do want to start from this 
place. To everyone in Funabashi—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I want them to witness my departure, 
fighting on behalf of Funabashi—!)

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Furi-chan, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
"Take it nice and easy~ Just, ya know, try 
not to hurt yourself~"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I turned my gaze toward the two who were 
calling out to Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm Furi-chan's friend! We spent a 
lot of time together at Funabashi Training 
Center.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
I hadn't talked with Trainer much before, 
so I'm super glad you remembered me~!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (Is that... Samin? And Myu too...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (You came for me. In that case—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso responds to the support of her 
close friend. Yet, the other Funabashi 
Umamusume are...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though... Is she really serious 
about taking down the JRA? Looks like 
she's over there training, but...”

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't that obviously impossible? I'm sure 
they'll be right back."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere wasn't buzzing with 
excitement. Toppling the Central realm was 
simply too distant a dream for the 
Funabashi Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(First—I will carve my first step of 
determination into this ground. And then—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I'll show everyone in Funabashi! Just how 
serious Trainer and I really are!)
